cand.title: ROMA Conference 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong organized hospitality-demand mechanism and confirmed Toronto date; venue commitment reduces current-edition accessibility.
cand.selectionWhy: Ledger shows competitor venue/hotel: Sheraton Centre Toronto

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Victoria van Veen, AMO Manager of Events, is explicitly named for ROMA 2027 sponsorship enquiries at Vvanveen@amo.on.ca and is the best first operational relationship contact; hotel-contract authority is not established. Petra Wolfbeiss, AMO Director, Membership Centre, is the second relevant contact: her portfolio includes education/events, and ROMA board minutes record her delivering conference-planning updates. Use the AMO main line 416-971-9856, extension 404, for Petra; no verified direct email is supplied here. Neither person is represented as the proven accommodation signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: January 24–26, 2027, Sheraton Centre Toronto, 123 Queen Street West, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. These are activity dates, not publication dates. Housing guidance strongly recommends Saturday January 23 arrival. No exact 2028 activity dates were located; do not infer them from annual recurrence.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: a 157-room Harbourfront city hotel can plausibly serve a modest municipal delegation, speaker/VIP lodging, or small side meeting; it cannot be exclusive housing or the main plenary venue for the published close-to-2,000-delegate conference. A 15–109-peak-room proposal is a hotel-fit sales envelope only, not measured ROMA demand. The conference is at Sheraton, so the hotel’s MTCC proximity does not establish event convenience. Do not promise catering, restaurant service, receptions or transport until operations and delegate logistics are verified.
findings.venueCommitments: Sheraton Centre Toronto is the confirmed 2027 conference venue and host hotel in downtown Toronto proper, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. Edition-specific contracted accommodation also includes Hilton Toronto Hotel, DoubleTree by Hilton at 108 Chestnut Street, and Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre. These are genuine conference-rate commitments, not a generic preferred-hotel list.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified Toronto/Sheraton recurrence: January 21–23, 2024; January 19–21, 2025; January 18–20, 2026; January 24–26, 2027. No destination rotation is demonstrated by these editions. October 17, 2025 FINAL board minutes approve the proposed Sheraton contract for 2028–2032 and direct staff to finalize it. December 19, 2025 draft minutes report continued Sheraton hosting for 2029–2032. The differing year ranges must be preserved; neither document supplies exact 2028 dates.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Organizer-negotiated blocks with direct hotel booking, not a separately identified housing bureau or open hotel RFP. Quote: “ROMA has negotiated special conference rates at the hotels below”; the page also calls them “conference contracted hotels.” Complete published 2027 list: Sheraton Centre Hotel (deadline December 23, 2026; quote ROMA Annual Conference 2027); Hilton Toronto Hotel (December 24, 2026; quote ROMA Annual Conference 2027); DoubleTree by Hilton, 108 Chestnut Street (December 24, 2026; group code CDT945); Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre (December 23, 2026; quote ROMA Annual Conference 2027). Official booking links and telephone routes are provided. A non-refundable one-night deposit is required. No block sizes, room-night totals or open supplementary-hotel procurement were published in the reviewed materials.
findings.organizationStructure: ROMA is an association and the rural voice/integral part of the Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO), not a corporate conference organizer, hotel or DMC. AMO staff support the conference and ROMA board governance approves venue decisions. No external PCO or accommodation bureau was identified in the reviewed edition-specific materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Four contracted hotels already cover the host and secondary-housing roles. ROMA lists secondary properties only 200m/3 minutes, 500m/7 minutes and 600m/9 minutes from Sheraton, strengthening the incumbent convenience proposition. The board cites accessibility, familiarity, cost-effectiveness and a positive Sheraton relationship in approving continuation. The hotel-page warning about a possible “rooms are sold out” message is generic policy, not evidence that any 2027 block is sold out. No verified overflow shortage or Radisson appointment was located.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Victoria van Veen through the published ROMA 2027 sponsorship route, ask her to identify the accommodation lead, and involve Petra Wolfbeiss for conference-planning/account direction. Ask whether the four existing blocks require additional rooms for January 23–26, 2027; request actual peak-room need, pickup/turnaway evidence, delegate logistics, and the next supplementary-housing review date. Offer a small, conditional room-only/VIP block subject to inventory, not full-conference relocation. If there is no documented shortfall, retain as future relationship development rather than an active 2027 group-room opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low and conditional, not proven closed to every ancillary sale: host venue and four hotel blocks are committed elsewhere, while no open accommodation RFP or request for extra hotels was identified. Radisson is not listed. Realistic 2027 access is limited to an organizer-approved supplementary block, independently booked delegation/VIP lodging, or a separately needed small meeting. These are inferred possibilities, not qualified demand or available inventory.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Recurring Toronto demand is verified, but do not pitch near-term displacement of Sheraton: October FINAL minutes approve a proposed 2028–2032 Sheraton agreement; December draft minutes confirm continued hosting for 2029–2032. Recommended inference: cultivate recurring secondary-housing and delegation relationships rather than claim an open future host competition. Exact 2028 dates, supplementary-hotel renewal windows and contract scope remain unverified. The AMO-conference RFP mentioned in the minutes is a different event and must not be treated as a ROMA RFP.
